title: fix(service-automation): a runAs:'user' run carries its user's posture rung, so a platform administrator's flow is served the ledger's deployment-level rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTTrKLU12Z9sF3RMpMJaEeG)_

Fixes #28070

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `RunIdentityContext` (barrel-exported), and so the data context `resolveRunDataContext` answers, gains an optional `posture` member, and `FlowUserGrants` gains one; a `runAs: 'user'` run seeded with `PLATFORM_ADMIN` is served the rows that rung admits.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here (`content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`, one sentence beside #26750's). `grep -rn -i "posture" skills/objectstack-automation` and `grep -n -i "runAs" content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: no text states which facts a `runAs: 'user'` run carries beyond positions / permissions / tenant, so nothing else to change.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`runAs: 'user'` 的自动化运行现在带上运行用户的姿态等级(posture rung),取自请求路径同一次 `resolveUserAuthzGrants` 解析，本包不做第二次推导。以平台管理员身份运行的流程，能读到审计账本里的部署级记录(`tenant_id` 为空),和他本人的请求一致。
- **为什么改**:#26750 之后部署级记录只给 `PLATFORM_ADMIN`,而运行上下文没有 rung,平台管理员的流程只看到组织行(收窄，不是泄露)。分诊裁定：走同一推导、不另起一套。
- **风险与回滚**:rung 只和推导出它的 grants 一起种下;门把已解析的 positions/permissions 带进来(含 agent 收窄上限)时不补 rung,不会放大。审批切换到裁决人时删掉提交人的 rung。`runAs: 'system'` 不变。回滚即 revert,无数据迁移。
- **先看**:`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`(`seedRunGrants` 与裁决切换各一处)、`runtime-identity.ts`(`resolveRunDataContext` 的 user 分支)、新测试 `runas-user-posture-rung.integration.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/runas-user-posture-rung.integration.test.ts`,预期 12 条全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The bridge** (`plugin.ts`). The grants bridge the automation plugin wires already calls `@objectstack/core`'s `resolveUserAuthzGrants` for the run's user; it now forwards that resolution's own `posture` beside the positions, permission sets, peers and email. Nothing in this package derives a rung.
- **The seed** (`run-resume.ts`, `seedRunGrants`). The rung is seeded exactly when the run's positions and permission sets are resolved at setup (the `needsGrants` branch), so it always stands beside the grants it was derived from. A context that brought its own grants (a door's pre-resolved envelope, an agent's narrowed ceiling) gains no rung from a re-resolution, though it still gains its peers and email as before.
- **The decision switch** (`run-resume.ts`, `deciderSegmentContext`). The submitter's rung is deleted with their other facts; the decider's segment is seeded with the decider's own. Without the delete, a decider the resolver answers nothing for would have kept a platform administrator's rung.
- **The data context** (`runtime-identity.ts`). `SeededRunContext.posture` and `RunIdentityContext.posture` (both typed `AuthzPosture` from `@objectstack/spec/security`); `resolveRunDataContext`'s user arm carries the seeded rung through `runPosture`, which drops a value that names no rung. The system arm is untouched.
- **Types** (`engine.ts`, two small hunks). `FlowUserGrants.posture`, typed as `SeededRunContext['posture']` so no import hunk; the `seedRunGrants` docblock (its contract) names the rung.

## Why

Triage `6522159967`: a `runAs: 'user'` run derives its rung through the same derivation a request uses, for the user it runs as, with no second derivation. Re-measured on `main` @ `549203d0`: `grep -n posture packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts` hit only two unrelated comments (lines 314, 820; tenancy posture), and the control test below shows the administrator's request without the rung (the shape a run carried) served the organization row only.

## Verification

Head `cfd3bf44`.

- `runas-user-posture-rung.integration.test.ts`, 12 tests, two layers. Envelope (bare engine, recording node, resolver stub): the rung rides the data context for a user-only trigger, for a member, after an approval decision (the decider's), and is absent for carried grants, for a value that is not a rung, for a decider the resolver answers nothing for, and on `runAs: 'system'`. Real stack (ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin, driver-sql on better-sqlite3, identity objects, SecurityPlugin, AuditPlugin's ledger read gate, the plugin's own bridge, `single` posture): the platform administrator's run is served every deployment-level `platform_admin_standing_change` row plus the organization's one; an organization holder of `view_all_audit_log` is served the organization row only, by run and by request, with or without the rung; a `runAs: 'system'` run is served all, as before.
- Ablation 1, `if (posture) out.posture = posture;` disabled in `runtime-identity.ts`: 4 red (the card's reproduction, plus three envelope cells); the member and system pins stay green (unchanged).
- Ablation 2, `delete switched.posture;` removed in `run-resume.ts`: 1 red (the unresolved decider keeps the submitter's rung).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: 228 files, 2888 tests, exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 93 families; they and `pnpm lint` are running locally. The reconciled `--ran` result goes in the os-dev report on the card; CI runs every family here too.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, card it: the REST automation door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:204-205`) and the action door (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2077-2078`) forward the request's `positions` / `permissions` but not `ec.posture`, so a flow started there carries grants and no rung, and still fails closed for the rung's readers. Forwarding it touches `AutomationContext` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`) or the door's extra-key shape. The changeset and the docs sentence say so.
- Request parity for the other readers of `ExecutionContext.posture` on a run (plugin-sharing `hasPlatformAuthority`, plugin-approvals' platform arm, observability's timing exposure): a platform administrator's run now answers as their request does. plugin-security's tenant-wall exemption already enforced the narrower of the carried rung and its capability probe, so a seeded rung never widens it.
